## Grid charge windows on the quarter hour, several per level

Time-of-day grid charges could so far hold one low and one peak window, in
whole hours. That is too coarse for Germany's Modul 3 under section 14a
EnWG, where every grid operator sets its own windows - some with two peak
windows a day, some starting at a quarter past. Thanks to Lars for pointing
it out.

Under **Reconfigure** the windows are now written as on the price sheet:

- Low rate windows: `00:00-06:00, 13:00-15:00`
- Peak rate windows: `07:00-09:00, 17:15-20:45`

Separate windows with commas and leave the peak field empty for a tariff
with two levels. Times must be on the quarter hour, as the meter counts,
and a quarter hour may not be both low and peak - the form says so instead
of guessing. An hour that a window splits is priced at the average of its
four quarters; the quarter-hour series gets each quarter's own rate.

**Nothing to do if your tariff already fits.** Entries set up before keep
their windows and prices exactly as they were, including stored plans. The
next time you reconfigure, the old hours appear as text (`17:00-21:00`).

## How do you use it?

A line in
[Discussions](https://github.com/BackupBaTTerY/energypriceforecast-home-assistant/discussions)
on your grid tariff and what you plan with it decides what comes next.
